reponse: Run `make dev-flags FLAGS=dashboards_v2` with the API running, then hard-reload the page; you can verify with `curl localhost:8000/api/flags` [3]. The earlier advice to set `FEATURE_FLAGS=new_dash` in `.env.local` is outdated: since PR #447 the front end reads flags from the API (`GET /api/flags`), the flag was renamed to `dashboards_v2`, and `FEATURE_FLAGS` is now ignored [2][3]. That explains the empty tiles you saw even with the old env var set [3]. Rollout is staged: internal workspaces Nov 16, Fernhill and Orbitly beta Nov 30, general availability in January [4].
